evidence.note: ELEMENT_META writes void and rawText together. area at 1945-1946 is void true and rawText false; iframe at 3046-3047 is void false and rawText true. Across the table the only stored pairs are false/false (115), true/false (21), and false/true (6). Both-true is never written.

notes: At most one of void or rawText is active; both-false is the ordinary, rcdata, and plaintext elements. textMode is a required literal, not a third boolean.
